questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Which place in your country do you like to visit the most, and why?
questions.sampleAnswer: I like to visit Da Lat the most. The weather there is very cool and nice. I love the beautiful flowers and quiet lakes. I usually go there with my family on holidays because we can relax together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What did you watch the last time you watched television?
questions.sampleAnswer: The last time I watched television, I watched a football match. It was a game between Vietnam and Thailand. I watched it with my father last Sunday. We were very happy because Vietnam won the match.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What is your favourite film, and why do you like it?
questions.sampleAnswer: My favourite film is Harry Potter. It is about a young wizard and his magic school. I like it because the story is very exciting and the characters are brave. I have watched it many times with my friends.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Describe the picture.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the picture, I can see a group of four young friends. They are sitting inside a dark cinema. They are sitting in comfortable red seats. There are two boys and two girls. They are watching a movie together. They look very happy and they are laughing. One of the girls is holding a big popcorn bucket. The bucket has red and white stripes. They are sharing and eating the popcorn. The big screen is glowing softly in front of them. The light from the screen is on their cheerful faces. They are wearing casual clothes like t-shirts and sweaters. They look very relaxed and they are enjoying their time together. I think they are close friends because they are having a great night out.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Tell me about the last time you went to the cinema. What did you see and who did you go with?
questions.sampleAnswer: The last time I went to the cinema was last month. I went there on a Saturday evening. I went with my best friend. We saw a funny comedy movie. We bought a large popcorn and two drinks to share. The cinema was very crowded but we had good seats. We laughed a lot during the movie. It was a very fun night and I felt very happy.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Why do you think many people enjoy going to the cinema?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think many people enjoy going to the cinema for several reasons. First, the cinema has a very big screen and great sound. This makes the movie more exciting than watching at home. Second, it is a good way to relax with friends or family. You can eat popcorn and have fun together. So, going to the cinema is a very popular activity for many people.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Compare these two pictures.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the first picture, I can see a couple buying food from a street food stall. It is outdoors on a city pavement. There is a friendly vendor and some steam coming from the food cart. This place looks cheap, quick, and very lively. In the second picture, a young woman is sitting inside a nice restaurant. She is giving her order to a waiter. This place is indoors, and it looks very comfortable, formal, and calm. However, it is also more expensive. I think the street food stall is great when you want a fast and cheap meal with friends. In contrast, the restaurant is better for a quiet and special dinner. I prefer the street stall because I love casual places.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

What are the disadvantages of eating in each of these two places?
questions.sampleAnswer: Eating at a street stall has some disadvantages. First, the weather can be bad. If it rains, you will get wet. Also, it is not very clean. For the restaurant, the main disadvantage is the price. The food is very expensive. Also, you have to wait a long time for your food because they cook it fresh. This can be boring.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Some people do not like eating out on their own. What do you think about eating alone?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think eating alone is actually fine. Sometimes I am very busy, so I just want to eat quickly. I do not need to talk to anyone, and I can choose my favorite food easily. However, eating with friends is more fun. We can talk, laugh, and share different dishes. So, I prefer eating with other people, but eating alone is okay sometimes.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 4 - Discuss an abstract topic

Please describe a time when you received a gift. What was the gift, who gave it to you, what was the occasion, and what did you do?
questions.sampleAnswer:
I’d like to talk about a time when I received a special gift. It was a blue backpack. My older sister gave it to me on my birthday last year. At that time, I was a university student, and my old bag was broken. The new backpack was simple, but it had many pockets for my books, phone, and water bottle.

On my birthday, my family had dinner at home. After the meal, my sister gave me a box with a card. I opened it and saw the backpack. I smiled and thanked her many times. Then I tried it on in front of my family. It was light and comfortable, so I used it for school the next day.

I felt very happy and surprised because I did not expect a gift. I also felt loved because my sister knew what I needed.

I think handmade gifts are very nice because people spend time making them. However, shop gifts are useful too. For me, the best gift is something that matches the person’s needs.
